Unchanged: the named readers, and #11973 staying `pm:blocked` on this card. Exit: when the enterprise-side reference is posted back here per the card's acceptance, this card closes and #11973's coordination half is disposed.

## Closing: both acceptance clauses are already satisfied — measured, not inferred

Routed here by the maintainer 2026-09-07 for dispatch. Before dispatching I checked the premise, and it has moved twice since this card was written on 2026-08-31. No implementation work is left.

### The premise this card rests on is no longer true

> ⛔ Why this card lives in `objectstack` and not at destination. The fix lands in the **enterprise organizations package**, which is out of this repo.

That package came **into** this repo today. PR #16215 (`c677cda81`, ADR-0132) brought the multi-organization runtime back to open core as `packages/plugins/organizations`; the enterprise side keeps only the licence gate. So the out-of-repo half this card was created to coordinate no longer exists as such — and the seam it was tracking closed from the other direction.

### Clause 1 — the wiring calls the predicate

Already true on **both** sides, and it did not arrive with the migration:

```
packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:5    import { isDefaultOrganizationBootstrapTrigger } from '@objectstack/plugin-auth';
packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:492  if (isDefaultOrganizationBootstrapTrigger(opCtx ?? {})) {
```

and in cloud, `packages/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:446`, identically. `git log -S` over the framework path returns only `c677cda81` — i.e. the code arrived already fixed, because cloud had adopted the predicate before the migration copied it verbatim. Nobody reported back here, which is the whole reason this card is still open.

The middleware carries the L4 reasoning in its own comment: the grant-insert arm never fires again on a walled deployment, so `kernel:ready` was the only run left and the default org never appeared — "which is how cloud's guided-path suite caught it".

### Clause 2 — the control, which this card was right to demand separately

> A control that the window is actually closed, not just narrowed … "It works after a restart" is the pre-existing behaviour and is **not** this acceptance.

`packages/plugins/organizations/src/walled-default-org-self-registrant.pin.test.ts` is that control, and it names this seam card in its header — *"The seam card's worry was a specific WIRING question."* Its cases are exactly the pair demanded:

- `the bootstrap really IS registration-triggered here — a 'sys_user' insert reaches the helper` — no restart anywhere in it
- `POSITIVE CONTROL — the same middleware DOES bootstrap the operator once their declared address verifies`

It also guards against the failure mode that would make a green meaningless, in its own words: an outcome-only assertion would be worthless, because *"no org was created" is also what an empty fake store says when nothing is wired at all* — so every negative case is paired with a positive control flipping exactly one fact.

### Disposition

Closing. `pm:awaiting-maintainer` is cleared: there is no maintainer routing left to do, because the destination repo became this one and the work was already done in it.

The named readers this card owed an answer to:

- **`domain:services` seat (#6021)** — the coordination half of #11973 is closed. ⛔ This does **not** close #11973's other half (the walled-rig end-to-end acceptance pass, vehicle #11978); the card said they are independent and that still holds.
- **maintainer / director seat** — nothing to route.
